reviews.title: Difficulties in subscriptions and poor customers support
reviews.text:
The experience of the app was good until I decided to pay for a subscription.

When I initially registered for the app I got the 30 days of trial. When the trial is about to end with one day left (oct 29), on that time I decided to pay for subscription. However, when I paid the starter subscription, the next day I can not use the app any more. I logged into my account from foreflight website. From there I can see my subscription shows cancelled, however I can also see the record that I actually paid for the subscription and the amount of payment matches my credit card record. 

I think it was a mistake and then I contacted the customer service by email. Next day I got a reply saying that a case number was created. And later another message asked me to provide my personal information which is very irrelevant which includes my DOB, my citizenship, my full name. I asked the reason why I have to give them these irrelevant information, then I got no reply anymore.

I also tried websites bot, it doesn’t work but keep sending me irrelevant websites link, and info from their website helped nothing to help I debug. I feel very upset about this customer support experience. 

With a 5 star app, the subscriptions system and poor customer support, this app is now a 2 star to me.

reviews.title: Bloated
reviews.text: FF use to be the best EFB but with every release it adds functionality that a typical GA pilot never uses and makes it bloated and slow.  Not to mention that to use these functions you have to pay for a higher-tier subscription.

reviews.title: Very pretentious and poor pilot support
reviews.text: Disappointing experience with ForeFlight’s customer support team. Rather than making a genuine effort to find a solution, the representatives were dismissive, defensive, and unnecessarily condescending in their communication. My concern remained unresolved, and the tone of their responses was surprisingly unprofessional for a company that prides itself on “Fanatical Pilot Support.”

reviews.title: Used to be good
reviews.text: Ever since ForeFlight was acquired by Thoma Bravo and decided it was a good idea to lay off more than 30% of the workforce, the app has been getting worse! With every update, it makes the app less user-friendly! We pay over 1000+ a month for Jeps, 2 iPads and 1 iPhone (current the subscription is only letting 2 IPads sign on so it’s not even working properly) and King Air Performance…. Prices keep going up quality keeps going down! We will be switching to Garmin Pilot as soon as we can get someone from customer service to reply to our emails. We have been sending an email a day for a week trying to get customer support and have only heard back from the automated email service! Sign of the times I guess! SAVE YOUR MONEY especially if you’re just starting your Avaition career!

reviews.title: New update is trash
reviews.text: I like to take notes on scratchpads and with the recent trash update, my notes are frequently and randomly deleted. I have been doing this for almost a decade now and have only run into this problem in the last few months. Also, get rid of the AI slop before you get someone killed.

reviews.title: Once great, now stalling
reviews.text: They have removed the ability to purchase a subscription through the app even though their own documentation still says it is possible. “Support” is unresponsive. Unfortunately, it appears this company is entering an uncoordinated stall.

reviews.title: ForeFlight’s downward spiral has begun
reviews.text: Like many of you, I was concerned when ForeFlight fired half of its staff after getting bought by a venture capital firm. I was ready for the asset strip to begin and this program to become slop. The chat-GPT plugin is the first example of this. Enjoy getting very inaccurate weather briefings. Hopefully no one dies because of this garbage.

reviews.title: Sleazy tactics
reviews.text: Price goes up every year, now they cut the SAFE discount in half. I am all done with ForeFlight, I knew once they were sold this was going to happen. Also w&b only includes fuel in the top tier. Sleazy

reviews.title: Unable to update
reviews.text:
ForeFlight is definitely going downhill fast. I’ve been trying to download updates FOR. TWO. DAYS!  It always gives me an error and I have to try the update again. It’s not my iPad and my WiFi is working just fine. This is what happens when you fire the technical staff and send development offshore. 

I’m done with ForeFlight and will not renew.

reviews.title: They fired a bunch of staff and now basic functions don’t work.
reviews.text:
Downloads don’t work consistently even with full service (verified stable connection). Downloads also don’t register as needing to be downloaded quickly anymore. Database gets old, I go to the downloads page to update and even though they are out of date the page doesn’t refresh to allow me to press the download button. When will the option open up? No clue, may take hours or may happen immediately. You have no control and can’t update in time for a flight. Downloads page is also stuck. Issue is not internet connection, and this is after an IPad restart. Same problem. Just frozen. Will not download.

Sharing flights with crew members now only works maybe 50% of the time. Constantly failing. 

These issues did not happen before they laid off critical staff. This app is basic infrastructure for the safe operation of flight. Get it together!

reviews.title: Private Equity
reviews.text: Looks like it was bought by PE. That’s usually the peak. App will now prioritize revenue over features customers want. Slowly will hollow out user base until new boutique app pops up to replace it and grows… is bought out by private equity also... and circle of life occurs again.

reviews.title: What happened
reviews.text: ForeFlight used to be great and it seems with every new recent update the app runs worse than before. The amount of times the app just bogs down doing anything is increasing, the weather and radar sometimes loads and sometimes doesn’t, and the amount of times I have to refresh a flight plan over and over again because of the “no winds” problem is absurd. At least the perf numbers and EOPs still work

reviews.title: Money Hungry
reviews.text: Pretty sad the price continues to increase and synthetic vision can’t be an add on any longer. You have to pay an extra $130 to bump up to the Essential package and don’t use half of the stuff in the package.

reviews.title: Poor App Support
reviews.text:
I lost a phone and was unable to log into ForeFlight . After numerous attempts with support (email only - terrible ) they just stopped responding ! 
I was never able to get back into my account !  Have lost my logbook for the last 6-7 years . 
Not a happy customer . 
Chuck B

reviews.title: Small weather fonts
reviews.text:
Sure would be nice if we could pinch and spread the weather line on METARS & TAFS to read them better in a bouncing airplane at night. 

I have asked about this numerous times and seems nothing is done about it,

The FF software writers should go fly at night in bad weather and report as to how they do!

reviews.title: WARNING
reviews.text: ForeFlight just cost us OVER $2,000 (yes, TWO THOUSAND DOLLARS (& yes, United States dollars)) due to their incompetence & lack of wanting to prevent this from happening to you. Disgusting.

reviews.title: Pricing is becoming outrageous
reviews.text: Love this app, but I’m not liking the direction the new owners are taking. ForeFlight was purchased by private equity and the transfer occurred in November of this year. It’s only been one month and they’ve already slashed the CFI discount from %33 to %15 and replaced it with a predatory referral program. I wouldn’t be surprised if the price increases soon either. I simply cannot support this.

reviews.title: App is trash now
reviews.text: Been using this app for years now. This last month it has become next to useless. Chunky, unmoving map. Lags like a 14.4k modem. Pretty much useless in air. Sellouts.

reviews.title: Started off great but headed in the wrong direction.
reviews.text:
I’ve used this app since 2018. It had a great team of developers who listened to their users.

Since then it was bought by private equity who fired a large portion of those developers to replace them with AI.

reviews.title: Document viewer
reviews.text: The update changed the document viewer so that you see 2 pages on the screen in landscape mode. It's horrible.

reviews.title: Was good, now just a waste of money
reviews.text: This app, has really gone in the toilet. Thank you to Boeing for selling a good product to someone to kill it, kind of like MTV did to every show. I think I will be soon relearning how to use garmin pilot for flying

reviews.title: Reducing support while hiking prices
reviews.text: Private equity strikes again. Price hikes coupled with a reduction in support engineers and development. Lost faith in the product and do not trust the company with my money

reviews.title: Once great app now declining rapidly.
reviews.text: Use to be hands down the best safety tool to have in the cockpit. Now there is constant price increases and poor support with decreased usability. Have been a customer since they first released on the App Store and it is now in one of the worst states I’ve seen it in. This week especially I have noticed increased bugs and app crashes that makes having this app in the cockpit dangerous. From incorrect TFR information to incorrect routing and poorly labeled frequencies, this list goes on. After reading other reviews seems the company has recently sold and just last week fired half of their staff which explains the long list of issues I’ve been having lately. I suggest finding an alternative that you can rely on while flying.

reviews.title: Get out while you can
reviews.text: This was the top-of-the-line best aviation app you could have until their private equity acquisition. Now I suggest you export your flight now a while while you can before the process increases keep coming.

reviews.title: Reducing support
reviews.text:
Foreflight was great but now they laid off 50% of their software developers so that they can offshore development.  
Your life is to important to trust to this product now.

reviews.title: Private Equity ruins another good thing
reviews.text: Private equity in the 2020s will go down as the single most infectious, terrible and evil thing to be spawned from capitalism. ForeFlight, a perfectly good, well made application designed for aviation and inspired by aviators, is being completed destroyed by private equity. Firing half the work force and then offshoring the hard work of individuals who dedicated themselves to this app will only make it a worse. Glad that my subscription renews soon so I can cancel it and move over to Garmin.

reviews.title: Traitors to American Workers
reviews.text: This company is private equity owned and has laid off 50% of its workforce. Improvements to the app and service interruptions will follow.

reviews.title: ForeFlight just laid of half of its staff, now owned by private equity.
reviews.text: Without wasting too much time, this app is heading towards the trash. Switching to Garmin pilot

reviews.title: Good App Overpriced
reviews.text: GeoReferenced plates should not be a premium feature, that’s a standard function and vital safety feature that many free apps provide. This app meanwhile is not only paid, but charges double just to have a georeferenced plate. These clowns love paywalls. Moved over to FlightPlan Go after using ForeFlight for 3 years and haven’t looked back since. Now as an airline pilot, I’ve I tinted instructing and never recommend this app to any of my students. There are much better and more affordable options out there!

reviews.title: Raising prices and lowering discounts.
reviews.text: ForeFlight continues to increase prices and now is choosing to lower SAFE discounts by half.

reviews.title: iOS lock-in
reviews.text: I get the reasoning behind developing only for iOS, but this team is well funded and they could easily expand to Google Pixel phones without having to support the myriad of android form factors , which would address their development overhead argument. Frankly AvareX is pretty good and completely open source which means this team should be able to pull off a rewrite in less than a year.
